# Justice Equity Need Index (JENI) Results

```{r}

#orange for JENI 2021
pal_impact <- colorBin(palette = c("#ffff00","#f2bf00", "#e68000", "#d94000","#cc0000"), domain = jeni$jeni_pctl, bins = 5, reverse = FALSE, pretty = FALSE)

#create popup
popup <- paste("<div class='hasjeni'> <div class='leaflet-data' data-zip='", jeni$zipcode,
               "' data-neighborhood='",jeni$lat_neighborhood,
               "' data-jeni-pctl='",jeni$jeni_pctl,
               "' data-jeni-category='",jeni$jeni_category,
               "' data-jeni-rank='",jeni$jeni_rank,
               "' data-population='",prettyNum(jeni$population_count, big.mark = ",", preserve.width = "none"),
               "' data-sd-number='",jeni$sd_number,
               "' data-sd-name='",jeni$sd_name,
               "' data-spa-number='",jeni$spa_number,
               "' data-spa-name='",jeni$spa_name,
               "' data-system-category='",jeni$system_category,
               "' data-drivers-category='",jeni$drivers_category,
               "' data-risk-category='",jeni$risk_category,
               "' data-system-pctl='",jeni$system_pctl,
               "' data-drivers-pctl='",jeni$drivers_pctl,
               "' data-risk-pctl='",jeni$risk_pctl,
               "' ></div></div>")



# create custom legend labels
labels <- c(
"Lowest (0-19th Percentile)",
"Low (20-39th Percentile)",
"Moderate (40-59th Percentile)",
"High (60-79th Percentile)",
"Highest (80-100th Percentile)")

# build map
leaflet(jeni, width = "100%", height = "600px", options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE)) %>%

# add base map
# new code: add base map
    addTiles(
      urlTemplate = paste0("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_nolabels/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=", carto_key),
      attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>, &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>'
    ) %>%
    addTiles(
      urlTemplate = paste0("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_only_labels/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=", carto_key),
      # attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>, &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>',
      options = providerTileOptions(pane = "markerPane") # retain unique setting 
    ) %>%
# add map panes
addMapPane("index_pane", zIndex = 400) %>%
addMapPane("missing_pane", zIndex = 410) %>%
# addMapPane("jeni_2019", zIndex = 415) %>%
addMapPane("jesi_2021", zIndex = 415) %>%
addMapPane("sds_pane", zIndex = 420) %>%
addMapPane("spas_pane", zIndex = 420) %>%


# set view and layer control
setView(-118.6368454, 34.2324274, zoom = 8.5) %>%
addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("Supervisorial Districts","Service Planning Areas", 
                                   # "JENI 2019 - High/Highest Need ZIP Codes", 
                                   "JESI - Low/Lowest Service ZIP Codes"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE, autoZIndex = TRUE)) %>%

# create sidebar and add html for content
addControl(html='<div class="leaflet-popup-scrolled"><div class ="zipcode-header" style="margin-bottom: 8px; margin-top: 8px;"><span class="square-icon"></span><span class="zip" style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;"></span></div><span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight:bold; line-height: 1.5em;">JENI Percentile*: <span class="jeni-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> | <span class="jeni-category color-format-jeni " style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br><span style="display: block; width: 95%"><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-jeni"></div></div></span><br>Component Percentiles*</span><br><span class="where" style="line-height: 1.5em; font-size: 12px; display: block; width: 95%;">System Involvement:  <span class="system-pctl" style="font-weight: bold;"></span><br><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-system"></div></div><br>Inequity Drivers:  <span class="drivers-pctl" style="font-weight: bold;"></span><br><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-drivers"></div></div><br>Criminalization Risk:  <span class="risk-pctl" style="font-weight: bold;"></span><br><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-risk"></div></div><br><br><span class="zip-details" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> has a <span class="jeni-category-details color-format-jeni"></span> overall need level. It also scores<span class="system-category color-format-system"></span> on System Involvement, <span class="drivers-category color-format-drivers" ></span> on Inequity Drivers, and <span class="risk-category color-format-risk"></span> on Criminalization Risk need.<br><br>Neighborhood:  <span class="neighborhood" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>JENI Rank: <span class="jeni-rank" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> out of 277 ZIP Codes<br>Population:  <span class="population" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>Supervisorial District:  <span class="sd-number" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span>  |  <span class="sd-name" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>Service Planning Area: <span class="spa-number" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> |  <span class="spa-name" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span></span><br><span style="font-size: 10px; font-style: italic;">*Percentiles range from 0-100. A higher percentile means a higher level of need in that area.</span></div>', position = "topleft") %>%
  
# add polygons for JENI ZIP Codes
addPolygons(color = "black", weight = 1, smoothFactor = 0.5,
            opacity= 1.0,
            fillOpacity = .8, fillColor = ~pal_impact(jeni_pctl),

,
```

```{js}
<!-- This function is used to color code degrees of JENI index ratings in "popup"/sidepanel feature -->

<!-- Captures  -->
var mapsPlaceholder = [];
L.Map.addInitHook(function () {
  mapsPlaceholder.push(this);
  mapsPlaceholder.forEach(map => {
    map.on('popupopen', (e) => {
    
    let popups = document.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-data');
    console.log(popups);

document.querySelectorAll('.hasjeni').forEach(hasjeni => {
hasjeni.parentElement.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('hidden')
})
  
popups.forEach((popup) => {
console.log(popup)
console.log(popup.getAttribute('data-jeni-category').trim())

document.querySelector('.zip').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-zip')
document.querySelector('.neighborhood').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-neighborhood')
document.querySelector('.jeni-pctl').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-jeni-pctl')
document.querySelector('.jeni-category').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-jeni-category')
document.querySelector('.jeni-rank').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-jeni-rank')
document.querySelector('.population').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-population')
document.querySelector('.sd-number').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-sd-number')
document.querySelector('.sd-name').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-sd-name')
document.querySelector('.spa-number').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-spa-number')
document.querySelector('.spa-name').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-spa-name')
document.querySelector('.zip-details').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-zip')
document.querySelector('.jeni-category-details').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-jeni-category')
document.querySelector('.system-category').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-system-category')
document.querySelector('.drivers-category').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-drivers-category')
document.querySelector('.risk-category').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-risk-category')
document.querySelector('.system-pctl').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-system-pctl')
document.querySelector('.drivers-pctl').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-drivers-pctl')
document.querySelector('.risk-pctl').innerHTML = popup.getAttribute('data-risk-pctl')


let components = ["jeni", "system", "drivers", "risk"]
  components.forEach(component => {
 
      let nodes = document.querySelectorAll('.color-format-' + component);
          nodes.forEach(el => {
              let categoryClasses = [component + "-lowest", component + "-low", component + "-moderate", component +                    "-high", component + "-highest", "category-color-error"]
```
